component.name: Muriel - myFinancialAdmin
component.summary: Local-first financial admin for freelancers and small businesses

description.p: Muriel - myFinancialAdmin is a local-first desktop app for client records, invoices, expenses, and reporting.
Data is stored locally on the user's device.

Updates for every install type: the AppImage and source checkouts can update themselves, and Snap and Flatpak installs get the install command. The Flatpak now encrypts the saved data, Copy reminder works again, and Electron is updated to 44.

Fixed data safety and money figures: invoice edits no longer lose the invoice, saves are crash safe, the safety backup is encrypted, restore accepts only Muriel backups, reports leave out draft invoices, VAT is rounded for each invoice, and dates use local time.
Fixed invoice PDF download from both the post-create invoice preview and the invoice list preview pane.
Added ability to edit existing clients directly from the clients list.
